rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-phase failure mode + escape hatch.
rules_evaluated.evidence: HARM this rule prevents: a phase carrying a forcing function fails silently in the room because no structured maintainer entry gives the trainer a quick failure-mode/recovery lookup. That harm is partially present here — Phase 5 (the re-send, moved into this file today) has a forcing function ({{prompt:ae101-m5-rerun-packaged}}, line 135) but the maintainer's own "Failure modes + diagnostics" list (lines 207-216) only itemizes Phase 1-4, with no Phase 5 bullet, even though Phases 1-4 each get two. The recovery content itself already exists in body prose (line 137: 'ask the agent to list the artifacts that didn't ship and quote the verifier output verbatim') so a trainer reading the body is not stranded, but the structured lookup format the other four phases get is missing for the newest phase.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add a Phase 5 bullet pair to the maintainer Failure-modes list (dominant failure: polished self-report masking partial ship; escape hatch: ask for the un-shipped artifact list + quoted verifier output) mirroring Phases 1-4's format.
